name: ModelVariant415_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant415_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the config row at data + 0x38 indexed by the request, gets five slot parts and packs its texture images before setting up three ribbons, two sheets, two sets of three strands, four rings, two lines and three sweeps, otherwise it runs one frame (sheets and bands from phase 2, ribbons and layers from the config timings) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every image that builds the entry; the European, French, German and Italian images build it through french_model_variant/variant432_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL palette x; HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
